_about: ClaudeMail settings shared by every machine. A machine overrides any of them in config/<machine>.json (lower case, e.g. config/stahlwerk.json), which only that machine edits. 'machines' are the folder names under mail/; 'hostnames' maps a hostname that is not simply the machine name onto one of them (the CLAUDE_MAILBOX_MACHINE environment variable overrides both). open_minutes: how long an opened session may take to start before its mail waits for the user; retry_minutes: how often such mail is tried again.
